ui_bugs.issue: Console warnings 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' STILL appear 4× on initial dashboard render despite minWidth/minHeight fix. Charts render correctly visually but the warning persists — likely because ResponsiveContainer is mounted inside a flex/grid parent that briefly reports 0 width before layout settles. Recommend wrapping in a div with fixed height (e.g., h-[320px]) or removing 100% width and using fixed pixel width.

action_items: Recharts width(-1)/height(-1) warnings still occurring on Dashboard. ResponsiveContainer minHeight prop alone is not enough — wrap each ResponsiveContainer in a div with explicit pixel height (e.g., style={{height: 320}}) or remove width='100%' in favor of a fixed parent.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 789 lines — close to the 700-line file-size threshold. Consider splitting into routers/ modules (auth.py, employees.py, payroll.py, leave.py, audit.py, pdf.py) before next iteration.
audit() is fire-and-forget within the request handler; if the audit insert fails it would surface as a 500 to the caller. Consider wrapping in try/except and logging instead of raising.

/api/payroll/runs/{rid}/bank-file CSV: beneficiary names containing commas are quoted, but bank_name and other fields are not — if a bank name ever contains a comma it will break parsers. Consider using csv.writer.

/api/payroll/runs/{rid}/payslip/{eid}.pdf path uses a literal '.pdf' suffix in the route — this works but may confuse some HTTP clients that strip extensions. Consider returning via Content-Disposition only and removing '.pdf' from the path.
Seed backfill loop on startup is O(N) with await per employee — fine for 10 but should use update_many for scale.
CORS still allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=False (carry-over from iter1).

rca of the issue: Recharts -1 warning RCA: ResponsiveContainer queries parent dimensions on first paint via ResizeObserver. When mounted inside a grid/flex container that hasn't resolved its content size yet, the observer fires once with -1 before the second pass. The minHeight prop only sets the SVG min height after layout is known — it does not prevent the initial -1 read. Mitigation: give the immediate parent of ResponsiveContainer a fixed height in pixels (e.g., <div style={{height:320}}> wrapping <ResponsiveContainer width='100%' height='100%'>) or set width/height to fixed pixel values.
